sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I – things got more subtle, more sort of surgical in my taste in performance, the things I choose to sort of frame up and try to amplify as a director.
sentences.zh: 我——事情变得更微妙了，我在表演品味上变得更精准了，在作为导演时，我选择去构图和放大的东西也更讲究了。

sentences.en: I just – I'm sort of tuned into a different frequency.
sentences.zh: 我只是——我好像调到了一个不同的频率上。

sentences.en: I don't know if it's a better one or a worse one, but different things – like I cry watching commercials now.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这到底是更好还是更糟，但有些事情变了——比如我现在看广告都会哭。

sentences.en: Never used to do that.
sentences.zh: 以前从不会这样。

sentences.en: But there's – you know, there's a whole side of me that is much, much softer now.
sentences.zh: 但是——你知道，我身上确实有一整面现在变得非常、非常柔软。

sentences.en: I cry watching Batman and Robin.
sentences.zh: 我看《蝙蝠侠与罗宾》都会哭。

sentences.en: And Jason tries to – but it's funny how Jason, he takes that question of like, yeah, and how it applies to him as an actor and a director, not as a human being.
sentences.zh: 杰森试图——但有趣的是，杰森他把那个问题理解为，是的，它是如何作为一名演员和导演应用在他身上的，而不是作为一个普通人。

sentences.en: Like a fucking robot.
sentences.zh: 就像个该死的机器人一样。

sentences.en: But – and, you know, because he has – there is no inner life.
sentences.zh: 但是——而且，你知道，因为他有——他根本没有内心世界。

sentences.en: When you scratch the surface, it's more surface.
sentences.zh: 当你触及表面时，下面还是表面。

sentences.en: But here – I will say this.
sentences.zh: 但在这里——我得说。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's totally – for me, I will say, as a human being – thank you, George, talking to another human being.
sentences.zh: 是的，这完全——对我来说，我想说，作为一个普通人——谢谢你，乔治，能和另一个普通人交流。

sentences.en: It completely shifted everything.
sentences.zh: 这彻底改变了一切。

sentences.en: Yeah, like you said, it – you reprioritize.
sentences.zh: 是的，就像你说的，它——你会重新排列优先级。

sentences.en: It's a brand new perspective.
sentences.zh: 这是一个全新的视角。

sentences.en: The perspective that I had for leading up to my first son at 38 completely shifted.
sentences.zh: 我在38岁生第一个儿子之前所持有的视角完全改变了。

sentences.en: And what I do, what my priorities are, whatever it is, does it fit my life?
sentences.zh: 我所做的，我的优先级是什么，无论是什么，它适合我的生活吗？

sentences.en: And by life, I mean does it fit my kid's life?
sentences.zh: 而说到生活，我的意思是，它适合我孩子的生活吗？

sentences.en: And so I find myself – I probably sold myself short a lot professionally because I tried to do everything I could for my kids.
sentences.zh: 所以我发现自己——我可能在职业生涯中因为试图为孩子们做我能做的一切而委屈了自己。

sentences.en: And I don't know if that's smart or at the end of the day somebody's going to say you should have been more selfish.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这是否明智，或者到最后会不会有人说你应该更自私一点。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: But it's just the way I did it.
sentences.zh: 但这只是我做事的方式。

sentences.en: Here's the funniest part of that.
sentences.zh: 这里面最有趣的部分是。

sentences.en: I mean, and I know what you're saying.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我知道你在说什么。

sentences.en: But there's – I don't think anyone is ever going to say at the end of the day,
sentences.zh: 但我觉得，到头来应该没人会说，

sentences.en: God, I wish we'd done two more interesting films rather than, God, I'm really glad I spent this time with my kids or I did this with my kids.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我真希望当时多拍了两部有趣的电影，而不是说，天哪，我真庆幸自己当时花时间陪了孩子，或者和孩子一起做了那些事。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's, I think, the part of the lesson that took me a long time to learn and having children has taught me, which is –
sentences.zh: 我想，这就是我花了很长时间才领悟到的道理，也是有了孩子后才教会我的，那就是——

sentences.en: and the pandemic is sort of teaching us all too, which is we're all learning how deeply connected we need to be
sentences.zh: 疫情也在某种程度上教会了我们所有人，我们都在学习我们需要建立多么深厚的联系，

sentences.en: and how important it is that we have other things besides our work.
sentences.zh: 以及除了工作之外，拥有其他生活是多么重要。

sentences.en: Because, you know, we know too many people who have been immensely successful in our industry.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道，我们认识太多在这一行极其成功的人了。

sentences.en: I mean, all of us have worked with major stars who are no longer stars.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们都和那些曾经的大牌明星合作过，但他们现在已经不是明星了。

sentences.en: You know, shit goes away.
sentences.zh: 你知道，风光总会过去。

sentences.en: Things change.
sentences.zh: 世事变迁。

sentences.en: The rules change.
sentences.zh: 规则也在变。

sentences.en: But it's – if you have this core, this family, these people that matter to you, then, you know, you can handle anything.
sentences.zh: 但如果你拥有这个核心，拥有这个家庭，拥有这些对你重要的人，那么，你知道，你就能应对一切。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I see Jason – all joking aside, I mean, you know, I gave Jason shit the other day.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我看着杰森——抛开玩笑不谈，我是说，你知道，前几天我还损了杰森一顿。

sentences.en: I passed him on Sunset.
sentences.zh: 我在日落大道上经过他。

sentences.en: He was dropped – and there he's driving his Hyundai Palisades, not as a plug, Jason.
sentences.zh: 他当时正把车停下——他开着他的现代帕里斯帝，杰森，我可不是在给它打广告。

sentences.en: It's a great car.
sentences.zh: 那车确实不错。

sentences.en: Great car, you know.
sentences.zh: 很棒的车，你知道的。

sentences.en: Oh, God.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: Got a fold-down seat in the back and –
sentences.zh: 后座还能折叠，而且——

sentences.en: And I see him and he's dropping Maple off at a friend's house, you know, at a – and, like, those are the things we've become –
sentences.zh: 我看到他正送梅普尔去朋友家，你知道，在——而且，那些就是我们变得——

sentences.en: it's so funny, 20 years ago, Jason and I would have been like, look at that clown driving around in the thing.
sentences.zh: 真好笑，20年前，我和杰森肯定会说，看那个开着那玩意儿的傻瓜。

sentences.en: And now we're – I'm passing him and I've just dropped my kids and he's dropping his daughter at the thing.
sentences.zh: 而现在我们——我经过他，我刚送完孩子，他正送他女儿去那儿。

sentences.en: That's what I was doing – by the way, when you guys were doing that, I was passing you, calling you clowns.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，你们当时那样做的时候，我经过你们，还在叫你们傻瓜呢。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I was like, look at those fucking clowns.
sentences.zh: 我当时心想，看那帮混蛋傻瓜。

sentences.en: I'm living the life.
sentences.zh: 我过得可潇洒了。

sentences.en: What do you –
sentences.zh: 你当时——

sentences.en: Well, now I'm literally, like, behind you cleaning up, you know, shit and washing, you know, everything.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在我真的就像是在你身后收拾烂摊子，你知道，处理那些琐事，洗这洗那的。

sentences.en: I find myself – you know, even whether you have kids or you're just in love, thinking about mortality more and also getting older.
sentences.zh: 我发现自己——你知道，无论你是有了孩子还是仅仅在恋爱中，都会更多地思考死亡，也会意识到自己在变老。

sentences.en: And then, you know, we just had this incident with Tiger in town and it made me think about you, George, about your accident.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，城里刚发生了泰格那件事，这让我想到了你，乔治，想到了你的那场事故。

sentences.en: I've never talked to you about it and I didn't do any reading about it when it did happen aside from, like, going, oh, God, I hope he's all right.
sentences.zh: 我从没跟你聊过那件事，事发时我也没去读过任何相关报道，除了心想，噢，天哪，希望他没事。

sentences.en: I didn't want to, you know, comb through it and stuff.
sentences.zh: 我不想，你知道，去翻看那些细节之类的。

sentences.en: But what was – and I don't mean to ask you to tell stories.
sentences.zh: 但是，是什么——我不是要让你讲故事。

sentences.en: I bet you told a bunch of when it actually happened.
sentences.zh: 我敢打赌你当时肯定讲过很多次了。

sentences.en: But did the Tiger incident bring back some of those memories for you with respect to your mortality now that you've got a family too, that there's an added thing to all of that?
sentences.zh: 但泰格那件事有没有让你回想起那些记忆？考虑到你现在也有了家庭，这是否让一切变得更加沉重了？

sentences.en: You're talking about Tiger Woods' accident in his car, like, quite a while ago.
sentences.zh: 你说的是泰格·伍兹很久以前的那场车祸吧。

sentences.en: And George had an accident in Italy, right?
sentences.zh: 而且乔治在意大利也出过事故，对吧？

sentences.en: I think Tracy saw that in the news, Sean.
sentences.zh: 我想特蕾西在新闻里看到了，肖恩。

sentences.en: Yeah, Tracy's got that.
sentences.zh: 对，特蕾西看到了。

sentences.en: Thanks for specifying which Tiger we're talking about.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你明确指出我们说的是哪个泰格。

sentences.en: Well, because we don't know when this is going to air and it's going to be a while later.
sentences.zh: 嗯，因为我们不知道这期节目什么时候播出，可能会过很久。

sentences.en: Right, another Tiger might become, yeah, famous.
sentences.zh: 没错，说不定到时候又会有另一个泰格出名了。

sentences.en: Well, look, I will say this.
sentences.zh: 好吧，听着，我得说。

sentences.en: I've been in a couple of funky situations before where I kind of thought it was going to be lights out.
sentences.zh: 我以前也遇到过几次糟糕的情况，当时我以为自己要完蛋了。

sentences.en: A couple of times in South Sudan where I thought – but I didn't have a family and kids and things.
sentences.zh: 在南苏丹有几次我以为——但我当时没有家庭、孩子和那些牵挂。

sentences.en: Look, I hit a guy at 70 miles an hour in a motorcycle and I was launched and knocked out of my shoes and hit the ground.
sentences.zh: 听着，我骑摩托车时以70英里的时速撞上了一个人，我被甩了出去，鞋子都飞了，重重地摔在地上。

sentences.en: And I broke his windshield in with my helmet and then went flipping up in the air.
sentences.zh: 我用头盔撞碎了他的挡风玻璃，然后整个人飞到了空中。

sentences.en: And I was fairly sure because I'd been riding for 40 years.
sentences.zh: 当时我相当确定自己要完了，因为我已经骑了40年的车了。

sentences.en: I was fairly sure I knew what that meant, which was probably that I'd broken my neck.
sentences.zh: 我当时相当确定自己知道那意味着什么，大概就是我的脖子断了。

sentences.en: And I read that you landed literally on your knees in your hands or something like that?
sentences.zh: 我读到过说你落地时真的是手脚着地，或者是类似的情况？

sentences.en: I landed on my hands and knees when I finally hit the ground.
sentences.zh: 我最终落地时确实是手脚着地。

sentences.en: You can actually watch it.
sentences.zh: 你们其实可以看录像。

sentences.en: There's CCTV footage of it and you can see me going – flipping through the air.
sentences.zh: 有监控录像拍到了，你们可以看到我整个人在空中翻转。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And, you know, I have to – it was just luck.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我不得不说，那纯粹是运气。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, if I'd landed on any other direction, I would have been, you know, definitely dead.
sentences.zh: 我是说，如果我当时是朝别的方向落地，我肯定已经没命了。

sentences.en: And so I remember this about it, which is an interesting thing.
sentences.zh: 关于这件事，我记得一个很有意思的细节。

sentences.en: I'm a pretty optimistic guy and I actually, you know, I look at the world in a fairly – you know, I always think the best of us.
sentences.zh: 我是一个相当乐观的人，我总是以相当积极的态度看待这个世界，总是往好处想。

sentences.en: But there was this moment when I hit the ground and Grant, my – one of my closest – maybe my closest friend and partner and –
sentences.zh: 但当我摔在地上那一刻，格兰特——我最亲近的朋友和搭档之一，或许是最亲近的——

sentences.en: The great and creative Grant Hesloff.
sentences.zh: 那位伟大且富有创造力的格兰特·赫斯洛夫。

sentences.en: Yeah, Grant Hesloff.
sentences.zh: 对，格兰特·赫斯洛夫。

sentences.en: You know, he was in the motorcycle ahead of me and he came running back and he's holding me.
sentences.zh: 他当时骑着摩托车在我前面，他跑回来抱住我。

sentences.en: I'm laying on the ground and I got glass in my mouth.
sentences.zh: 我躺在地上，嘴里全是玻璃渣。

sentences.en: I thought it was my teeth.
sentences.zh: 我当时以为那是我的牙齿。

sentences.en: It was a windshield glass in my mouth.
sentences.zh: 其实那是挡风玻璃的碎片。

sentences.en: And I really thought this was it.
sentences.zh: 我真的以为自己要完了。

sentences.en: And all the people that got out stood over me and once they realized it was me, pulled out their cameras and started, you know, taking pictures.
sentences.zh: 周围那些围过来的人，在认出是我之后，竟然掏出手机开始拍照。

sentences.en: And I'll remember that forever because I always think, you know, that moment that was probably going to be your last was somebody's entertainment for –
sentences.zh: 我会永远记住那一幕，因为我总在想，你以为可能是生命中最后的一刻，竟然成了别人的娱乐消遣——

sentences.en: And it doesn't make me bitter.
sentences.zh: 这并没有让我感到愤世嫉俗。

sentences.en: It just changes my perception of why, you know, is it that important that I have to please everybody and all the – you know, it's that thing of just going, okay.
sentences.zh: 它只是改变了我的看法，让我觉得，我真的有必要去取悦所有人吗？就是那种感觉，好吧。

sentences.en: I get it.
sentences.zh: 我明白了。

sentences.en: Fair enough.
sentences.zh: 也对。

sentences.en: You know, if that's how it is, you know, I thought it was a little more than that.
sentences.zh: 如果现实就是这样，那我也认了，我原本以为人性不止于此。

sentences.en: But you got to take care of you first and foremost at all times.
sentences.zh: 但你必须时刻把照顾好自己放在第一位。

sentences.en: So it's kind of – yeah?
sentences.zh: 所以这算是——是吗？

sentences.en: No, not that – I don't think in terms of that.
sentences.zh: 不，不是那样，我不是从那个角度去想的。

sentences.en: I just think in terms of, you know, sometimes we get kind of caught up in the idea that it's more than just entertainment or something like that.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得，有时候我们太沉迷于那种认为这不仅仅是娱乐之类的想法了。

sentences.en: Yeah, the expectation on human beings is lowered a little bit when stuff like that happens.
sentences.zh: 没错，当那种事情发生时，人们对人性的期待确实降低了一些。

sentences.en: Well, we see it – you see somebody fall on the subway in New York and everybody pulls out their phone and you go, put your fucking phone down.
sentences.zh: 我们都见过，你在纽约地铁看到有人摔倒，所有人掏出手机，你真想说，把你们那该死的手机放下。

sentences.en: Yeah, and lend a hand.
sentences.zh: 没错，去搭把手啊。

sentences.en: Jason and I got in a taxi accident in New York like a year and a half ago on 23rd Street.
sentences.zh: 大约一年半前，我和杰森在纽约23街出了一场出租车事故。

sentences.en: And we got on the side and we're like, geez, and the cab's smoking.
sentences.zh: 车子侧翻了，我们当时想，天哪，而且车还在冒烟。

sentences.en: And we look over and there's a kid right next to us filming us.
sentences.zh: 我们转头一看，旁边有个小孩正在拍我们。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, we're like, hey, man.
sentences.zh: 对，我们当时说，嘿，伙计。

sentences.en: Can you use that phone to call the cops, please?
sentences.zh: 能不能用那手机帮我们报个警？

sentences.en: Yeah, that was the thing.
sentences.zh: 没错，当时就是这样。

sentences.en: Call the cops.
sentences.zh: 报警。

sentences.en: Call the ambulance.
sentences.zh: 叫救护车。

sentences.en: I actually told this story.
sentences.zh: 其实我也讲过这个故事。

sentences.en: I got hit by a car on 57th Street like four years ago.
sentences.zh: 大约四年前，我在57街被车撞了。

sentences.en: And he was doing at least 40 and I was looking the wrong way and he spun me out.
sentences.zh: 那车至少开了40迈，我当时看错了方向，车把我撞得转了好几圈。

sentences.en: And I landed on my feet, but I kind of spun.
sentences.zh: 我落地时站住了，但整个人转了起来。

sentences.en: I came so close to death because he just caught – he just sort of sideswiped me.
sentences.zh: 我离死亡只有一步之遥，因为他只是擦到了我。

sentences.en: And I got to the other side and I was so fucking rattled right at Park Avenue.
sentences.zh: 我走到马路对面，在公园大道那边，我整个人都吓坏了。

sentences.en: And I get over to the other side and I look – and I'm like, Jesus Christ, I almost fucking died.
sentences.zh: 我走到对面，看着这一切，心想，天哪，我刚才差点就死掉了。

sentences.en: Look at this guy.
sentences.zh: 看看那个人。

sentences.en: He's looking at me and I go, did you see that?
sentences.zh: 他盯着我看，我问他，你看到了吗？

sentences.en: And he goes, yeah.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，好啊。

sentences.en: Can I get a picture?
sentences.zh: 我能拍张照吗？

sentences.en: And I went, Jesus, I almost fucking died, asshole.
sentences.zh: 我就说，天哪，我差点被你吓死，混蛋。

sentences.en: But, you know, George, you bring up something –
sentences.zh: 但是，乔治，你提到了一个——

sentences.en: Did you take the picture, though?
sentences.zh: 不过你拍那张照片了吗？

sentences.en: That's what's important.
sentences.zh: 那才是重点。

sentences.en: I did take the picture because he seemed like a genuine fan.
sentences.zh: 我确实拍了，因为他看起来是个真诚的粉丝。

sentences.en: But, George, you – I went to – I remember one time – I don't know if you remember this.
sentences.zh: 但是，乔治，你——我记得有一次——我不知道你还记不记得。

sentences.en: The first time we really met – I was with John Krasinski.
sentences.zh: 我们真正第一次见面时，我和约翰·卡拉辛斯基在一起。

sentences.en: We went for sushi.
sentences.zh: 我们去吃了寿司。

sentences.en: And you guys were working on Leatherheads at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时你们正在拍《爱情达阵》。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And there's a great thing.
sentences.zh: 那件事很有意思。

sentences.en: We gave you – I gave you a ride back to your house and this struck me.
sentences.zh: 我们送你——我开车送你回家，这件事让我印象深刻。

sentences.en: And I loved it.
sentences.zh: 我特别喜欢。

sentences.en: And you were directing a movie and you're George Clooney and you've done all this great stuff.
sentences.zh: 你当时在执导一部电影，你是乔治·克鲁尼，你已经成就了那么多伟大的事业。

sentences.en: And you're doing more great stuff.
sentences.zh: 而且你还在继续创造更多伟大的作品。

sentences.en: And I was really – I really – and kind of Sean mentioned it before, too.
sentences.zh: 我当时真的——我真的——肖恩之前也提到过。

sentences.en: You know, you've done – and you talked about it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你做过——你也谈到过。

sentences.en: You've done all these pilots.
sentences.zh: 你拍了那么多试播集。

sentences.en: You know, I did, like, seven pilots.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我拍了大概七个试播集。

sentences.en: I had 50 canceled shows.
sentences.zh: 我有50个节目被砍了。

sentences.en: I did every variation that you could of cancel before it went.
sentences.zh: 在节目被砍之前，我经历过各种各样的取消方式。

sentences.en: Got fired off a show before it got picked up.
